title: Structural coefficient morphism on lifted etale sheaves
statement: Structural tensor-section pullback to base-changed etale objects defines a natural transformation of lifted tensor-section presheaves. For quasicoherent modules it is a sheaf morphism from the lifted coefficient of F to g_* of that of G, and these morphisms respect every commuting square of module coefficient maps. The conventions and constructions are those of [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison], [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map].

proof.text:
Apply the existing abelian sheafification instance to each open slice.

Apply the existing abelian sheafification characterization on each slice.

The pushforward section comparison is restriction along the terminal
isomorphism. The coefficient component is the lifted structural section map.
Functoriality of coefficient lift identifies their composite.

Equality of morphisms of sheaves reduces to equality on each section.
The defining coefficient maps are the lifted structural section maps. Their
commutativity is coefficient naturality of the structural section formula,
and applying ULift preserves that equality.

theorem qcoherentPullbackSheafMap_naturality {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (g : Y ⟶ X) {F F' : SheafOfModules.{u} X.ringCatSheaf}
    {G G' : SheafOfModules.{u} Y.ringCatSheaf}
    [hF : SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent (R := X.ringCatSheaf) F]
    [hF' : SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent (R := X.ringCatSheaf) F']
    [hG : SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) G]
    [hG' : SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent (R := Y.ringCatSheaf) G']
    (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G)
    (ψ' : (tensorPullback g).obj F' ⟶ G') (a : F ⟶ F') (b : G ⟶ G')
    (hab : (tensorPullback g).map a ≫ ψ' = ψ ≫ b) :
    coherentEtaleMap F F' a ≫ qcoherentPullbackSheafMap g F' G' ψ' =
      qcoherentPullbackSheafMap g F G ψ ≫
        (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).map (coherentEtaleMap G G' b)
